items.label: Soft Material
items.value: The asymmetrical neck summer tops are made of soft, skin-friendly, lightweight, breathable and stretchy premium quality knit fabric, comfortable and flattering to wear for going out, business casual, date, vacation and more.

items.label: Stylish Design
items.value: Our dressy casual blouses features a trendy asymmetrical diagonal V-neck and ruched details, adding a touch of modern fashion to your everyday outfits. Slim fit t-shirts are designed to enhance your curves, show your figure greatly, make you sexy, elegant and confident.

items.label: Easy Match
items.value: These trendy t-shirts can be dressed up or down effortlessly, look stylish with jeans, cargo pants, skirts, shorts, jackets and so on, a must-have versatile fashion piece for spring and summer

items.label: Occasion
items.value: The cute y2k top is an excellent choice for various occasions, from casual daily wear to going out, streetwear, work, office, dates, night out, concert, club, party, birthday, holiday, beach vacations, travel, festival and more.

items.label: Tipps
items.value: S=US 4-6, M=US 8-10, L=US 12-14, XL=US 16-18. Please read Size Chart before ordering. Hand wash or machine wash with similar color in cold water, do not bleach, hang to dry, do not use a dryer to dry. Warm Note: Due to the different monitor settings and the lighting, the actual colors may look slightly different from the pictures.
